words: forty-eight years before anyone invented the can opener
Meet Marcel, a very hungry soldier
the army sent him a crate
His boot. The boot hurts more
He smacks it with a frying pan. Nothing
He sits on it. Still nothing
Marcel hurls it at a tree. The tree loses too
Who sells food nobody can open
often heavier than the food inside
The label instructions: Cut round the top
Gaston grabs a chisel and hammer
The first American can opener came in 1858
Soldiers got it in the Civil War
